_comment: DECISION 2026-10-08: values replaced with parameters/tables/T08_assignment_tiers_US_candidate.csv's real US tier values (HCM 7th ed. / NCHRP 825 planning-level reads) -- previously these were the UK-relabeled values FLOOD_TABLE_REVIEW.md flagged as the central audit finding (arterial 2200 veh/lane-h and 60 mph vs. the real US 900 and 45; collector 1700/55 vs 700/40; local 1000/35 vs 550/30). T08's own flow_breakpoint column is not a usable single number for 3 of 4 tiers ('n/a (use BPR)', and freeway is a range) because T08 assumes a classic BPR a/b power-law congestion curve, which this codebase's actual edge-speed model does not implement -- it uses a piecewise-linear breakpoint+slope model instead (see networks/t08b_profile.py). flow_breakpoint/congestion_factor below are therefore DERIVED from T08's real flow_cap_plph/free_flow_speed via that same piecewise-linear model's own documented formulas (Q_bp = 0.85 x capacity; slope = free_flow_speed / (1.15 x capacity) -- NCHRP 825 Exhibit 128's own linearization, already used identically in resiflow.networks.t08b_profile and verified there against the real exhibit), not read literally off T08's BPR-oriented column. See docs/FLOOD_TABLE_REVIEW.md.
